description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlModuleService component, verifying connection establishment, disconnection, registration, shared memory access, acknowledgment handling, and failure scenarios.

methods.name: shouldEstablishConnection
methods.description: Test that the client can establish a connection with the control service.

methods.name: shouldDisconnect
methods.description: Test that the client can disconnect from the control service.

methods.name: shouldFailToRegisterClient
methods.description: Test failure scenario when registering a client with an invalid controller.

methods.name: shouldRegisterClientAndUnregisterItWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Test that a client registers successfully and unregisters upon disconnection.

methods.name: shouldRegisterClientAndUnregisterItWhenDestructed
methods.description: Test that a client registers successfully and unregisters upon object destruction.

methods.name: shouldGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Test successful retrieval of shared memory.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Test failure to retrieve shared memory.

methods.name: shouldFailToAckWhenControlServiceReturnsFailure
methods.description: Test acknowledgment failure handling when the control service returns failure.
